name: Nee, Nee? Dou Suru!? ~Nami to Mina to Tokidoki Boku~
original_name: ねえ、姉？どーする!? ～ナミとミナと時々ボク～
source:
The main character has an older sister, Minami, who is also his homeroom teacher. One day, a mysterious phenomenon happens to them. Her body is divided into two bodies, and becomes two girls, Nami and Mina!? Their strange cohabitation starts now, involving their neighbor, Hisoka. What will happen to them in the end?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主人公有一位姐姐南，她同时也是他的班主任。一天，两人身上发生了神秘现象：姐姐的身体竟一分为二，变成了奈美与美奈两个女孩！？他们与邻居密一起开始了奇怪的共同生活。最终等待众人的会是什么？

[摘自ErogeShop]
